name: NeRF-Neural ODE
definition: A volume rendering technique that replaces the discrete quadrature summation of NeRF with a continuous Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE) solver to integrate radiance and transmittance along rays.
summary: NeRF-Neural ODE replaces standard discrete ray integration with a continuous Neural ODE solver, treating rendering as a dynamical system solved via adaptive integration rather than fixed steps.
